title: Fix Libass Subtitles
ai_description: Subtitles fail to display with libass rendering
source_message_text:
# Latest Beta

### Anime/Subtitle Customization
- **Libass Subtitles should only work for .ass subs (ignore other formats):** Subtitles fail to display when the libass rendering option is selected. (Note: This feature is intended for .ass subtitles only).

### Navigation/Search
- **Universal Search Redirect:** When searching globally, selecting a novel result incorrectly opens the MangaReader instead of the appropriate Novel reader.
